summary: WIRED's Scott Gilbertson rounds up 78 handpicked deals for Amazon's October 2023 Prime Day sequel, officially called Prime Big Deal Days. Deals span Amazon devices, laptops, tablets, watches, phones, headphones, kitchen gear, mattresses, smart home, vacuums, toys, TVs, cameras, and travel. The guide also explains the event dates, Prime membership requirements, invite-only deals, and competing retailer sales.
one_line: WIRED's curated list of 78 tested, handpicked deals from Amazon's October 2023 Prime Big Deal Days across tech, home, kitchen, and more.
key_facts: Amazon's Prime Big Deal Days ran Tuesday, October 10 through Wednesday, October 11, 2023, ending at 2:59 am ET on October 11 (11:59 pm PT).
Deals started flowing at 3 am EST on October 10; most require a Prime membership, which costs $15 a month and includes free two-day shipping, though a 30-day free trial is available.
Invite-only deals, introduced during the summer 2023 Prime Day, show a "Request Invite" button on eligible products, with no guarantee of receiving an invite.
The Echo Dot (5th Gen) deal includes a free smart plug that typically sells for about $20; the Echo Show 8 is WIRED's favorite Echo Show.

The Kindle Kids is on sale at $80 ($40 off), but lacks the adjustable warm lighting and waterproofing of the pricier model; Amazon includes a case, a one-year Amazon Kids+ subscription, and a two-year replacement guarantee.
The 2023 MacBook Air (8/10, WIRED Recommends) has a six-speaker sound system, a 1080p webcam, and a 10-core variant of the M2 processor.
The Google Pixel 7A is WIRED's favorite smartphone for most people (8/10, WIRED Recommends) at the lowest price the outlet has tracked, with wireless charging but only OK battery life.
The Helix Midnight Luxe Hybrid Mattress deal requires code DEALDAY25 and includes two pillows; it matches the best price WIRED has seen for its favorite mattress.
The Niu KQi3 Pro is WIRED's favorite electric scooter for most people, with 18 to 20 miles of range and a 20 mph top speed.
The Anker 737 Power Bank has a 24,000-mAh capacity, charges from zero to full in an hour, and is WIRED's top upgrade pick in its Best Portable Chargers guide.

The SanDisk 2-TB Extreme Portable SSD has been reported by Ars Technica and other users to have high failure rates, mainly in the 2- and 4-TB versions; SanDisk issued a firmware update that seems to fix it.
The GoPro Hero10 Black (8/10, WIRED Recommends) was recently dropped to $249, and the deal adds an extra battery, case, and small tripod.
WIRED says other retailers like Best Buy, Target, and Walmart run competing sales, and some deals may be better saved for Black Friday and Cyber Monday.
